message.description: Concatenation of all of the error messages for the obj (with already substituted parameters).

parameters.description: Parameters applied to {@link template} to produce error message.

httpStatusCode.description: http status code for this error

filenameOfRootError.description: Filename for where the error originated from

debugInfo.description: Extra debugging information, such as script language stack.

action.description:
Action information, e.g. "Dog#throwStaticSandwichJsError"
It should include argument types in case of overloaded methods.

engine.description: Engine of the action that threw this error

timestamp.description: Timestamp when the error was thrown

_system.description:
If this is the innermost Error / root cause and is created by a native Java exception, this field will be
that native Java exception.
Otherwise, this is an intermediate "wrapping" Error, and this field will be the corresponding C3RuntimeException.
We rely on this field to keep track of Java stacktrace.

targetType.description: Target type of obj that the error(s) was/were encountered for.

targetId.description: Target id of obj that the error(s) was/were encountered for.

info.description: Additional info about the errors (e.g. deser source).

fieldErrors.description: fieldErrors are not to be persisted in PG

title: Errors returned for a single obj in the {@link ObjList.errors} array for various operations on {@link Persistable}.
name: ObjSourceError
